# Dark Media — Complete Technical & Services Specification

## Agency Overview
- **Legal Entity / Name**: Dark Media
- **Core Specializations**: Digital Web Development, Brand Identity & Strategy, Cinematic & AI Video Production, Data-Driven SEO, Performance Marketing.
- **Headquarters**: Mangaluru, Karnataka, India
- **Primary Regional Markets**: India, United Arab Emirates (Dubai), Saudi Arabia (Riyadh), Oman (Muscat).
- **Track Record**: 400+ brands served across technology, e-commerce, real estate, healthcare, retail, and corporate sectors.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Framer Motion, Cloudflare Edge Deployment.
- **Website Domain**: https://www.darkmedia.tech

---

## Detailed Service Breakdown

### 1. Web Development (`/services/web-development`)
- **E-Commerce Websites (`/services/web-development/ecommerce-websites`)**: High-converting custom e-commerce web applications built with Next.js, headless Shopify, Stripe/Razorpay/GCC payment gateway integrations, ultra-fast edge caching, and mobile-first UX.
- **Corporate Websites (`/services/web-development/corporate-websites`)**: Enterprise-grade corporate web platforms built for speed, security compliance, sub-second page loads, and multi-language capability.
- **Web Applications (`/services/web-development/web-applications`)**: Custom full-stack React/Next.js SaaS applications, internal portals, client dashboards, and dynamic cloud software solutions.

### 2. Branding Agency (`/services/branding`)
- **Brand Identity Design (`/services/branding/brand-identity-design`)**: Comprehensive brand books, logo design, color palettes, typography rules, component systems, and physical/digital brand assets.
- **Rebranding Strategy (`/services/branding/rebranding-strategy`)**: Full repositioning retainers for established firms updating market presence for global expansion in India and GCC markets.

### 3. Video Production (`/services/video-production`)
- **Corporate Video Production (`/services/video-production/corporate-video-production`)**: 4K cinematic corporate visual storytelling, facility overviews, executive interview series, and investor decks.
- **Commercial Ad Films (`/services/video-production/commercial-ad-films`)**: TV commercial production, high-conversion digital video ad campaigns, scriptwriting, casting, and post-production VFX.
- **AI Video Production (`/services/video-production/ai-video-production`)**: Next-generation generative video scaling, automated multilingual dubbing, AI-assisted video editing, and hyper-personalized video ad variations.

### 4. SEO & Growth Analytics (`/services/seo-analytics`)
- **Local SEO Services (`/services/seo-analytics/local-seo-services`)**: Hyper-targeted local search ranking strategies, Google Business Profile optimization, and local map pack dominance for businesses in Mangaluru, Dubai, Riyadh, and Muscat.
- **Technical SEO Audits (`/services/seo-analytics/technical-seo-audit`)**: Code-level Next.js site architecture reviews, Schema.org structural JSON-LD injections, Core Web Vitals optimization, indexing troubleshooting, and crawl budget optimization.

### 5. Social Media Management (`/services/social-media-management`)
- **Performance Marketing (`/services/social-media-management/performance-marketing`)**: High-ROI paid ad management across Meta (Instagram/Facebook), Google Ads, TikTok Ads, and LinkedIn Ads optimized for cost-per-acquisition (CPA).
- **Content Creation & Reels Studio (`/services/social-media-management/content-creation-reels`)**: High-frequency short-form video reels, viral TikTok/Reels content packages, visual design, and social media community management.
